title: Entity measurements
responsibility: Shows recorded measurements beside frozen limits and declared performance tolerances.

inputs.name: EntityMeasures.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with budgets, limits and identity. Supplies performance workloads and frozen-policy declarations.

inputs.name: EntityMeasures.record
inputs.description: Required record or null. Measurements and findings are filtered to the unit; unprofiled values supply source/complexity/dependency metrics.

outputs.name: EntityMeasures
outputs.description: Measurement table including source bytes, complexity, dependencies, emitted size and declared performance budgets. Distinguishes policy from numeric limits. Missing record/performance budgets are explicit; helper-formatted values and notes remain visible without estimating data.
